slug: 2025-01-17 Zambia Advances Digital ID System with MOSIP Training for Healthcare Integration

systems.country_label: MOSIP-based digital identity and eKYC platform

note: Reports developer training (January 2025) on integrating MOSIP identity verification with SmartCarePro, funded through the World Bank's Digital Zambia Acceleration Project; it states nothing on where the record system is used, who owns or funds it, or how data is entered, and the event is older than twelve months.
